verdict.rationale: Stripe documents an official MCP server that gives AI agents tools to interact with the Stripe API, and a probe confirms it is documented at docs.stripe.com/mcp. That covers connecting an agent via an official MCP server for the Stripe platform this product is part of. missing for 10: evidence that the MCP tools cover crypto/stablecoin operations specifically, connection/setup details, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Stripe Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides tools that AI agents can use to interact with the Stripe API
official MCP server documented at https://docs.stripe.com/mcp
